description: Create and publish (or schedule) a post to one or more connected social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram). Provide media as either a remote URL (mediaUrl fetched by the server) or a local file path (mediaPath read from disk) — exactly one media source per call. Omit scheduledFor to publish immediately.

caption.description: Main text/caption content of the post

imagePaths.description: Multiple local image file paths (mediaKind=image, carousel posts)

mediaKind.description: Whether the attached media is a single video or one or more images

mediaPath.description: Local filesystem path to the video, or to a single image

mediaUrl.description: Publicly fetchable URL of the video, or of a single image

platforms.description: Target platforms and their per-platform metadata

metadata.description: Platform-specific options (privacy, tags, category, etc). See the platform metadata tables at https://qpost.dev/docs

scheduledFor.description: ISO datetime; if omitted the post publishes immediately

name: create_post
